mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 35 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in a waxing crescent phase, and we expect an overnight low of 30 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Municipal Court is reminding residents that while many traffic citations can be paid online, mandatory appearances or O W I cases require direct communication with the clerk. Additionally, the City Plan Commission is reviewing proposals for Liberty Business Park ahead of their December 7th meeting.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 Thursday Nights both happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or head to the Dane County Farmers' Market on Saturday.
In a notable call for service on October 25th, officers conducted an O W I arrest after discovering a driver stopped in an intersection.

Today's flavor, Devil's Food Cake, has come to an end as the shop is now closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10:00 AM when the featured flavor will be Raspberry Cheesecake.
